title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the maximum kinetic energy T of the pi mesons as T_pi <= 5.44 MeV.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate an understanding of energy conservation in the decay process.

title: Velocity Comparison
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the requirement that the velocity of the muon in the center-of-mass frame exceeds that of the pi meson in the lab frame.

title: Momentum Relations
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply momentum conservation principles to relate the momenta of the decay products.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all energies are expressed in consistent units (MeV).

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes when calculating the momentum or energy of the decay products.

title: Mass Values
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly use the provided mass values for the pi meson and muon in their calculations.

title: Derivation Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include detailed derivation steps leading to the final answer for clarity.
